Linear Design & Construct focuses on the long term needs of our clients, whilst ensuring the highest standards of safety and quality. As a principal contractor, we strive to ensure the right expertise to inform the right solution, tailored to the specific requirement of our clients. Our approach and experience means we can minimise complexity and deliver efficiency which has long term benefit to both client and project. We are committed to honesty and integrity from the outset of every project, through to the very best aftercare. For us it is truly about taking a long term view about both the relationship and the project to ensure we understand the needs of our clients at each and every stage. Our team combines the optimum mix of skills and experience to manage a wide variety of projects, in terms of scale and specialisms, which also allows for both pace and agility in the delivery of projects. Linear Building Compliance Services Linear Building Compliance provides services to a variety of building users across the UK . Including Construction & FM companies, Consultants, Local Authorities, Building Owners, Estate Managers and Landlords. 01 Fire Risk Assessments Regular fire risk assessments are a fundamental part of effective fire safety management. Our experienced assessors carry out detailed inspections to identify fire hazards, assess levels of risk, and provide tailored recommendations that support compliance, reduce risk, and enhance occupant safety. 02 Fire Door Services Regular fire door inspections are essential for ensuring your passive fire protection measures remain effective. Our qualified inspectors assess fire doors for compliance, performance, and condition, providing clear reports and actionable recommendations to help keep your building safe, compliant, and protected. 03 Fire Stopping Fire stopping plays a critical role in maintaining a building's passive fire protection. We provide inspection, installation, and remediation services to seal breaches in fire-rated compartments, helping to contain fire and smoke, improve safety, and ensure compliance with current regulations. 04 Fire Alarm Services LBC provides a complete fire alarm service, including design, supply, installation, and maintenance. Backed by our BAFE SP203-1 accreditation, we deliver tailored solutions that enhance building safety, reduce false alarms, and ensure ongoing compliance throughout the life of your property. All systems are installed and maintained by our qualified, accredited team. 05 Fire Extinguisher Services Maintaining fire extinguishers is essential to ensuring they remain safe, compliant, and effective in an emergency.
